<thought>To provide a valid answer I must retrieve real reaction‑template IDs from the database. I will query the template catalog for each of the six required transformations, using the functional‑group descriptors that are available. For each forward reaction I will supply a representative product SMILES and indicate the functional groups that are formed (and, when possible, the groups that are broken). Once I have six template IDs I will assemble the retrosynthetic tree in the required JSON format.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "O=S(Nc1ccccc1)Cl",
  "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
  "functional_groups_broken": ["acyl chloride"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
